# Viral Sync Auditor Packet

This packet is a self-contained review bundle for Viral Sync POC-1 proof-of-conversion artifacts.

Start with:

1. docs/POC-1.md
2. docs/invariant-matrix.md
3. app/public/proofs/devnet-causal-commerce.json
4. app/public/proofs/devnet-causal-commerce-verifier.json (published copy) and tmp/devnet-causal-commerce-verifier.json (raw verifier output)
5. app/public/proofs/fraud-gauntlet.json
6. app/public/proofs/proof-feed.json
7. schemas/
8. sdk/src/index.ts
9. artifact-hashes.json
10. how-to-reproduce.md
11. final-command-transcript.txt, when present after a final run
